context: Evaluates whether the candidate correctly uses the useCart SWR hook from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce to fetch and display cart state. Tests knowledge of the hook's return shape (data, isLoading, error, isEmpty) and proper rendering logic for loading, empty, and populated cart states.

checklist.name: Uses useCart hook
checklist.description: The component imports and calls useCart from @vercel/commerce-kibocommerce (not a custom fetch or useEffect).

checklist.name: Handles isLoading
checklist.description: The component checks the isLoading return value from useCart and renders a loading state while data is being fetched.

checklist.name: Uses isEmpty property
checklist.description: The component uses the isEmpty property from the cart data (not manually checking lineItems.length === 0 without using the property).

checklist.name: Renders line items
checklist.description: When the cart has items, the component renders each item from data.lineItems showing at least the name and quantity.

checklist.name: Correct hook access pattern
checklist.description: The hook is accessed correctly through the commerce provider context (not as a standalone import outside of provider context).
